title: CPF Module Schema: Chaos Studio Experiment module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-chaosstudioexperiment'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.
prerequisites: Proximity Placement Group for Windows Virtual Machine

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

chaos_studio_agent_target_mi.description: (Optional) The managed identity clientid, secret and tenantid to register the vm agent target { clientId = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx" tenantId = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx" type = "AzureManagedIdentity" }

chaos_studio_agent_target_subnetids.description: (Optional) The relay and container subnet id to register private aks target { containerSubnetId = "/subscription/xxx/xxx/xxx/xx" relaySubnetId = "/subscription/xxx/xxx/xxx/xx" }

chaos_studio_capability_type.description: (Required) Type of the Capability for Azure Chaos Capability

chaos_studio_target_enabled.description: (Optional) Whether the target registration is necessary or not. If a target has multiple capabilities it can be registered only once

chaos_studio_target_id.description: (Optional) The chaos studio target id that is needed only when additional capabilities are needed for a already registered target

chaos_studio_target_resource_id.description: (Required) Resource ID of the Target Resource for Azure Chaos Target Resource

chaos_studio_target_type.description: (Required) Type of the Target Resource for Azure Chaos Target Resource

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

identity.description: (Optional) An identity block as defined below object({ type = "(Required) Specifies the type of Managed Service Identity that should be configured on this Windows Virtual Machine. Possible values are `SystemAssigned`, `UserAssigned`, `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned` (to enable both)." identity_ids = "(Optional) Specifies a list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs to be assigned to this Windows Virtual Machine. This is required when `type` is set to `UserAssigned` or `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned`." })

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

name.description: (Required) Specifies the name which should be used for this Storage Mover.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

selectors.description: (Required) A selectors block supports the following: # chaos_studio_target_ids = "(Required) A list of Chaos Studio Target IDs that should be part of this Selector." selector_name = "(Required) The name of this Selector."

steps.type: map(object({ branch = map(object({ experiment_branch_name = string actions = map(object({ action_type = string duration = optional(string) parameters = optional(map(any)) selector_name = optional(string) urn = optional(string) })) })) experiment_step_name = string }))
steps.description: (Required) A map of Steps block supports the following: object({ branch = (Required) A map of branch blocks as defined below: object({ experiment_branch_name = "(Required) The name of the branch." actions = (Required) A map of branch blocks as defined below: object({ action_type = "(Required) The type of action that should be added to the experiment. Possible values are `continuous`, `delay` and `discrete`." duration = "(Optional) An ISO8601 formatted string specifying the duration for a delay or continuous action." parameters = "(Optional) A key-value map of additional parameters to configure the action. The values that are accepted by this depend on the urn i.e. the capability/fault that is applied." selector_name = "(Optional) The name of the Selector to which this action should apply to. This must be specified if the action_type is continuous or discrete." urn = "(Optional) The Unique Resource Name of the action, this value is provided by the azurerm_chaos_studio_capability resource e.g. azurerm_chaos_studio_capability.example.urn. This must be specified if the action_type is `continuous` or `discrete`." }) }) experiment_step_name = "(Required) The name of the Step." })

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

capability_id.description: The Resource ID of the Azure Chaos Studio.

chaos_studio_experiment_id.description: The Resource ID of the Azure Chaos Studio.

chaos_studio_experiment_name.description: The Name of the Azure Chaos Studio.

chaos_studio_target_id.description: The Resource ID of the Azure Chaos Studio Target.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Chaosstudioexperiment' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
prerequisite_modules: Proximity Placement Group for Windows Virtual Machine
